evals.prompt: our google cloud bill jumped about 30% last month and i genuinely don't know why. we have the billing export in bigquery. can you work out what changed and whether it's something we did?
evals.expected_output: Establishes the settle gate before quoting numbers; finds the step date rather than splitting the delta; separates attributable from demand/other-team changes; keeps MEASURED vs INFERRED apart.

evals.prompt: run the monthly cloud cost review for september
evals.expected_output: Follows Mode A: settle gate, invoice reconciliation, run rate on gross, step detection, new-or-resumed SKU check, regression sweep, one priced opportunity, and a 'not checked' section.

evals.prompt: i found network intelligence center costing us like $60/mo in the billing console. worth turning off? what breaks?
evals.expected_output: Checks the credits array BEFORE pricing, discovers the 100% proportional discount, and reports that the net saving is $0.00 rather than recommending the change.

evals.prompt: we want to scale our staging kubernetes namespaces to zero outside working hours to save money. can you set that up?
evals.expected_output: Prices the realisable (idle-fraction) saving rather than gross, insists the automated reaper be EXECUTED not reviewed, and flags the silent-hang failure mode plus the need for a lease and docs at the point of confusion.
